claims.claim: The Files API lets you upload and manage files to use with the Claude API without re-uploading content with each request
The Files API is currently in beta and requires the header: anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14
Upload endpoint is POST /v1/files which returns a unique file_id for referencing in Messages requests
Download endpoint is GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content for files created by code execution tool or skills
Files you uploaded cannot be downloaded; only files created by skills or code execution tool can be downloaded
Maximum file size is 500 MB per file
Organization storage limit is 100 GB total
Filename must be 1-255 characters and cannot contain characters: <, >, :, ", |, ?, *, \, /, or unicode 0-31
File API operations (upload, download, list, retrieve, delete) are free; file content used in Messages requests is priced as input tokens
Files are scoped to the workspace of the API key; other API keys in the same workspace can use files created by any key
Images are supported in all Claude 3+ models
PDFs are supported in all Claude 3.5+ models
Various file types for code execution tool are supported in Claude Haiku 4.5 and all Claude 3.7+ models
The Files API is NOT supported on Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
Supported document formats include: PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, ODT, HTML
Supported image formats include: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP
The Files API integrates with the code execution tool for providing inputs (datasets/documents) and downloading outputs (charts)
Files API was announced as one of four new agent capabilities in October 2025 alongside code execution tool, MCP connector, and prompt caching
The upload response includes: id, type, filename, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at, and downloadable fields
Files can be referenced in Messages requests using content blocks with type 'document' and source type 'file' with the file_id
Python SDK supports file uploads via client.beta.files.upload(file=Path('/path/to/file'))
TypeScript SDK supports various file input methods including File objects, fetch Response, fs.ReadStream, and toFile helper
Agent Skills for document processing include: pptx, xlsx, docx, and pdf skills
Files created by Agent Skills must be downloaded via the Files API; they are not automatically saved locally
The code execution tool gives Claude ability to run Python code in a sandboxed environment to produce computational results and data visualizations
Code execution environment includes libraries: pyarrow, openpyxl, xlsxwriter, pillow, python-pptx, python-docx, pypdf, matplotlib, pandas, polars
Code execution tool provides 50 free hours per organization per day, then $0.05 per hour per container
Files are inaccessible via the API shortly after deletion but may persist in active Messages API calls
Common error codes: 400 (invalid file type/filename), 403 (storage limit exceeded), 413 (file exceeds 500MB limit)
The Files API provides a create-once, use-many-times approach: upload once, receive file_id, reference across multiple conversations
